main_text.l: biliter conuenientium confseffu, comparandus.Intelligent illos coetus visibiles esse domum illam Dauidis, in qua perennis aquae fons sit apertus, qua peccata hominum delentur, & immunditiae purgatur, vt ait Zacharias c.13. Intelligent quāobrem idē Dauid Dei propheta, quum & patriasuauissima,& vxore charissima, & bonis omnibus in exilio tristfsimo careret, vnum tamen illum visibilem Ecclesiae coetum (à quo tunc aberat) magis,quàm illa omnia desiderarit,seque illi reddi cum tantis suspirijs exoptarit, exclamans psal.84. Quàm amabilia sunt tabernacula tua Domine exercituum: Desiderio afficitur, etiamque deficit anima mea, veniendi ad atria tua. Denique intelligent illud esse verissimum, quod consentienter Dei verbo scripsit Augustinus Sermone 108. de Temp.

page.notes: The first line reads "biliter conuenientium confseffu," which is probably "confessu"; the first word is a fragment of "similiter". Long s throughout is printed as plain s in the transcription. Some words in italics are uncertain near the page edge.
